Australian State and Territory Population Data

population_tidy.Rd

Population estimates are taken from the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS). The dataset contains June population estimates for each year.

Usage

data(population_tidy)

Format

A data frame with 128 rows and 3 variables:

year

Year of the population estimate (2010-2025).

state

State or territory abbreviation.

population

Estimated resident population in persons.

Source

Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS), National, state and territory population, Table 4: Estimated Resident Population, States and Territories. https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/people/population/national-state-and-territory-population

Details

Annual estimated resident population for Australia's eight states and territories from 2010 to 2025.
